LESSON: SCRIPTURES AND MORAL VALUES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: General
Strand: Scriptures
Topic 3.1: Scriptures and Moral values
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Scriptures and Moral values, part of Scriptures in Grade 6 General.

Key inquiry question: How do Scriptural stories contribute to instilling moral values? 2. How can we apply teachings of scriptures to instilling moral values?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read scriptures that enhance moral values, in groups,

2. listen to stories/resource persons/audio- visual devices to know about the role of the Scriptures,

3. share stories from Scriptures that explain their roles as carriers of moral values,

4. recite mantras from Scriptures based on their roles to instil moral values,

5. use search engines to identify the Scriptural stories that enhance moral values in the community,

6. hold discussions on the role of Scriptures,

7. assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching lessons drawn from the Scriptural stories. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read scriptures that enhance moral values, in groups,
2. listen to stories/resource persons/audio- visual devices to know about the role of the Scriptures,
3. share stories from Scriptures that explain their roles as carriers of moral values,
4. recite mantras from Scriptures based on their roles to instil moral values,
5. use search engines to identify the Scriptural stories that enhance moral values in the community,
6. hold discussions on the role of Scriptures,
7. assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching lessons drawn from the Scriptural stories. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Scriptures and Moral values together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: Learner enhances digital skills when using search engines to identify the Scriptural stories that

enhance moral values in the community.

● Learning to learn: Learner organises their own learning when listening to stories/resource person/audio-visual device to

know about the role of the Scriptures.
